items.title: How are you dealing with all the negative side effects of AI on the web?
items.excerpt: It seems to me that the AI hype killed the web for good, but not for the reasons we immediately associate with it. Search engines now rank links full of slop at the top, which ironically make LLM summaries acceptable, not because they are better than what we had before (they are not), but because they at least mention the good links which are now buried at the bottom of the page. items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.excerpt: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows. Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. items.title: datasette #3046: Don't serve link: rel=next HTTP headers to Firefox for HTML pages

This was happening because Datasette pages serve an HTTP link header like this: link: ; rel="next" This is bad.
